title: My Sister Took Her Own Life

current_concerns.primary_problems: Grief since my sister died by suicide in April of last year, with crying, difficulty concentrating at work, withdrawing from friends, and feeling guilty because I did not notice the warning signs.
current_concerns.goals: To get through a day without crying and to be able to talk about my sister without breaking down.
